# Fase 33 etapa 10 (F1, V073): what a contract costs the player, one vector per line. One sum for
# the charge (WOSK_WorkerAliasScript.ContractCost), the log, and the panel's estimate
# (ui-prisma model.contractCost): read by the Python reference tests (test_contract_cost.py) and
# ui-prisma/tests/price-and-state.test.ts; the Papyrus side is held to the same numbers by the
# harness items PRC40-PRC44 in HWTest_HonestWork.psc.
#
#   cost = ceil(units x (reference x multiplier + max(ingredients, 0)))     every step in float32
#   ingredients -1 (an ingredient that does not resolve) counts 0
#
# The expected values were worked out apart from the code under test (plain arithmetic in the
# comment), not produced by it.
#
#   units reference multiplier ingredients expected
#
# 4 x (2 x 1.9) = 15.2
4 2 1.9 0 16
# 5 x (6.528 x 1.4 + 5.44) = 72.896
5 6.528 1.4 5.44 73
# 2 x (77.6219 x 1.4 + 10.5) = 238.34
2 77.6219 1.4 10.5 239
# 10 x (1.65 x 1.9) = 31.35
10 1.65 1.9 0 32
# 3 x (5 x 2) = 30, an unresolved ingredient left out
3 5 2 -1 30
# an exact figure does not tip over a gold: 4 x 2.5 x 2 = 20
4 2.5 2 0 20
# 10 x 0.1 = 1, float32 keeps it at 1
10 0.1 1 0 1
